## Description

Diagnostic-only counterpart to Twi054. For a specific edge pair `(num-1, num)`, the analyzer determines whether they form a notch and returns the index of the short edge plus the parameter on the long edge at which the long edge could be split to flatten the notch.

## Reproducer recipe

As Twi054, querying the specific notch triplet.

## Expected kernel behavior

return short-edge index and split-parameter; do not modify the wire.
